tipFirstTaskBody: A couple of words is enough. You can edit it anytime.
tipAddToProjectBody: Grouping by project keeps your list and reports tidy.
tipGiveDateBody: Dated tasks move to Planned and show up on their day.
tipNestTasksBody: Right-click a task to make it a project, or press + to add steps.
tipNestTasksTouchBody: Long-press a task to make it a project, or tap + to add steps.
tipProjectFilterBody: Pick a project to see only its tasks. Drag its grip to reorder.
tipTimerModesBody: Stopwatch counts up, countdown runs to a length you pick, pomodoro alternates focus and breaks.
tipTimerLengthBody: Tap a chip or type your own minutes.
tipCalendarTimeBody: Drag a task onto the day grid, or draw a block on empty space.
tipCalendarTimeTouchBody: Long-press a task and drag it onto the day grid, or draw a block.
tipAnalyticsBody: Time, Money and Habits each answer one question about your work.
tipPlannedBody: Tasks with a date sit here until their day, so nothing gets lost.
tipArchiveBody: What I did lists finished tasks by day, so you can see how a week went.
tourAddTaskBody: A couple of words is enough.
tourTryBoardBody: The same tasks, shown as cards you can drag.
tourMoveToDoingBody: Drag the card to the next column.
tourMoveToDoingTouchBody: Press and hold the card, then drag it to the next column.
tourStartTimerBody: Use the card's ⋯ menu: Start timer. Time goes to this task.
tourStartTimerTouchBody: Tap the card's ⋯ button: Start timer. Time goes to this task.
tourStopTimerBody: Press the timer on the card to stop it.
tourStopTimerTouchBody: Tap the timer on the card to stop it.
tourMoveToDoneTouchBody: Press and hold the card, then drag it to Done.
tourBackToListBody: Board and list show the same tasks. Switch anytime.
tourStopTimerWidgetBody: Press the running timer to stop it.
tourAnalyticsBody: The minutes you just tracked are here.
tourFinishBody: Calendar plans your day. Tips live in ? → Help.
welcomeStep1Subtitle: Plan your day, track your time, keep it all in sync.
welcomeStep2Title: What will you mainly use DayForge for?
welcomeStep2Subtitle: We'll set things up to match.
welcomeStep3Subtitle: Give it a name, or start from a template.
welcomeAccountSigninHint: Sign in with Google and pick up where you left off.
welcomeAccountSignupHint: Sign up with Google to sync across devices.
welcomeAccountLocalHint: Everything stays in this browser. You can sign in later.
welcomeUsePlanHint: Tasks, projects and a calendar for the day.
welcomeUseTrackHint: A timer for focus, with pomodoro breaks.
welcomeUseFreelanceHint: Hours, rates and what each client owes.
starterSubtitle: Three questions and you get a day you can actually try.
starterNote: Creates the goal “{goal}” with the project “{project}”. You can change or delete any of it.
tourChapterDoneBody: Pick another chapter any time in ? → Help.
tourSchedOpenBody: The calendar button sets a date and time for the task.
tourSchedWhenBody: Change the date, start or end. The task lands on that day.
tourSchedRepeatBody: Open Repeat to make it daily, weekly or every few days.
tourSchedAddBody: Press Add. It shows on its day and in Planned.
tourSchedEndBody: An end before the start means the next day; you’ll see +1 day.
tourSchedPlannedBody: Dated tasks wait there until their day.
tourCalOpenBody: Your day laid out on a time grid.
tourCalViewsBody: Day, Week or Month. Pick the span you plan in.
tourCalDragBody: Take a task from Unscheduled and drop it on an hour.
tourCalDragTouchBody: Press and hold a task in Unscheduled, then drop it on an hour.
tourCalBlockBody: Drag over an empty stretch of the grid and name it.
tourCalFilterBody: Show only the projects you pick in the filter.
tourTimerOpenBody: Track time with a stopwatch, a countdown or pomodoro.
tourTimerModeBody: Stopwatch counts up. Countdown and pomodoro have set lengths.
tourTimerStartBody: Press Start. Time goes to the task you pick.
tourTimerStopBody: Press Stop. The sitting is saved to your history.
tourTimerHistoryBody: Edit an entry's time or task from the history below.
tourTimerAwayBody: If you were away, the timer asks what to do with that time.
tourHabitScheduleBody: Habits are tasks that repeat. Open the schedule to set one.
tourHabitRepeatBody: Open Repeat, pick a rule, then add the task.
tourHabitCardBody: The project's Habits card shows each repeat day and streak.
tourHabitTabBody: It shows each month: done, missed and due days.
tourMoneyRateBody: Project settings hold the rate. Earnings use it.
tourMoneyClientsBody: Clients group your projects for billing summaries.
tourMoneyBudgetBody: A budget warns you at 80% and again at 100%.
tourMoneyTabBody: It totals earnings per project and per client.
tourMoneyExportBody: Save a CSV or print a report for the period.
tourShortQuickKeyBody: N opens quick add from any screen. Try it now.
tourShortQuickTouchBody: The + in the top bar opens quick add anywhere.
tourShortDatesBody: Type tomorrow or today in quick add to date a task.
tourShortSearchKeyBody: Find any project or task. / works too.
tourShortSearchTouchBody: The search button in the top bar finds any project or task.
tourShortReorderBody: Drag a project's grip to move it. Tasks reorder the same way.
tourShortReorderTouchBody: Press and hold a grip, then drag it to a new place.
tourShortMenuBody: Right-click a task for quick actions.
tourShortMenuTouchBody: Long-press a task for quick actions.
tourShortHelpBody: Press ? for shortcuts. Tour chapters live there too.
tourShortHelpTouchBody: Tap ? in the sidebar for shortcuts. Tour chapters live there too.
tourSetLanguageBody: Format holds the language. The app switches at once.
tourSetThemeBody: Light, dark or follow your system. Colours have their own section.
tourSetStartBody: Behaviour sets the view the app opens on.
tourSetAccountBody: Sign in to sync across devices. Without it, data stays in this browser.
